Filing Compliance Trend Over Time

Source: R/functions.R
gst_compliance_trend.Rd

Computes average filing percentage per month, optionally grouped by region or state, for GSTR-1 or GSTR-3B.

gst_compliance_trend(
  return_type = c("GSTR-1", "GSTR-3B"),
  by = c("national", "region", "state"),
  financial_year = NULL,
  state = NULL
)

Arguments

return_type

character(1). "GSTR-1" or "GSTR-3B".

by

character(1). "national" (default), "region", or "state".

financial_year

character vector. NULL = all.

state

character vector. NULL = all.

Value

A data.table with month_date and avg_filing_pct.

Examples

gst_compliance_trend("GSTR-3B", by = "region", financial_year = "2023-24")
